summary: Security review of climb-recording share SEO (origin/development...HEAD on cursor/seo-recording-share-5f7b): no critical or high findings. Identity parser rejects (never defaults) and 404s; listing OG sanitizes junk without 500; recording OG/metadata/share 404 unknown ids and never render the homepage card; canonical/OG/share URLs take an explicit origin from resolveBaseUrl() (never Host/Origin); share JSON is an allow-list DTO (no Prisma spread, no replay_token/seed/email/INTERNAL_TOKEN); /r/{cuid} enumeration accepted (A-7) with zero sitemap /r/ rows plus fail-open share-JSON rate limit; middleware matcher still excludes /r/ so INTERNAL_TOKEN is not forwarded for recording unfurls; F-1 peakY remains untrusted display (A-8) and is not a new critical; no getOrCreate on public GET; tweet intent is a fixed https://twitter.com/intent/tweet prefix with encodeURIComponent; JSON-LD is JSON.stringify + < → \u003c (recording JSON-LD interpolates rounded peak only, not handle); zero new packages. nextStage qa-acceptance.
goal: SEO for sharing climb-recording links on X, TikTok, and YouTube so a marketing agent can post them and crawlers unfurl a unique preview (title, description, image, canonical URL) per recording.

pingsAnswered.insight: F-1 / peakY is out of scope; cards are untrusted display; do not add AC-17 re-sim
pingsAnswered.applied: No finding claims this PR authenticates scores. Copy is 'Watch the replay' / integer metres only. Cited A-8 / ADR-8.

pingsAnswered.insight: Canonical/OG/share builders must not use request Host; sanitize OG; 404 unknown ids; omit token/seed/email; do not sitemap /r/
pingsAnswered.applied: Builders take origin only; callers pass resolveBaseUrl(). sanitizeOgText on listing params. Recording 404 via getShareableClimbRun. Allow-list DTO. buildSitemapEntries never emits /r/.

pingsAnswered.insight: Do not add /r/ to the view-credit matcher; single isBot; no getOrCreate on public GET; allow-list DTO
pingsAnswered.applied: middleware config.matcher unchanged (/, /dashboard, /stack, /b). isBot imported from botList.ts. Public GET is findUnique + parseRecordingId. getShareableClimbRun maps id/peakY/handle only.

pingsAnswered.insight: JSON.stringify of payload data must not contain replay_token/seed/INTERNAL_TOKEN
pingsAnswered.applied: Confirmed production mapper + tests. Share route returns {ok:true,data} of SharePayload only.

pingsAnswered.insight: AC-40 is matcher + unauthenticated generateMetadata, not a live bot GET
pingsAnswered.applied: Security agrees: matcher exclusion is the control that prevents 401 and INTERNAL_TOKEN forward. Live Twitterbot GET remains QA/e2e.

threatChecks.threat: Recording id parser: reject never default; path traversal; proto keys; 500 vs 404
threatChecks.notes: parseRecordingId returns null for empty/whitespace/slash/dot/percent/over-32/proto keys; getClimbRunRow skips Prisma on null; all HTTP callers 404. No demo-id default.

threatChecks.threat: OG query params XSS / 500; recording OG 404 unknown ids, never homepage card
threatChecks.notes: listing GET /api/og sanitizes name/rank, coerces alt, try/catch never-throw sanitizer. Recording serveRecordingOg 404 JSON NOT_FOUND when getShareableClimbRun is null. Separate Node routes, not listing edge defaults.

threatChecks.threat: Canonical/OG/share URLs must not use request Host/Origin
threatChecks.notes: urls.ts origin-only. Share GET, r/[id], robots, sitemap, record metadata, ClimbScene, ShareRun, dashboard all pass resolveBaseUrl(). No headers.get('host') in app/. Client anonymous token URLs also use resolveBaseUrl(), not window.location.origin.

threatChecks.threat: Share JSON must not leak replay_token, seed, email, INTERNAL_TOKEN
threatChecks.notes: Allow-list ShareableRecording + SharePayload. Prisma select is id/peak_y/replay_token(check-only)/userId/user.display_name. DTO omits token. shareHandle/redactShareHandle strip @. Route JSON.stringifies result.data only.

A-7 / R-1. Sitemap has zero /r/ paths (buildSitemapEntries). Payload omits secrets. Share JSON has fail-open 60/min IP limit (recommended, implemented). Page/OG unrate-limited — spec does not require it.

threatChecks.threat: Do not add /r/ to middleware view-credit matcher
threatChecks.notes: config.matcher still ['/', '/dashboard/:path*', '/stack/:path*', '/b/:path*']. Middleware change is isBot import only. Recording unfurls cannot trigger INTERNAL_TOKEN fetch.

threatChecks.threat: F-1: do not claim this change authenticates peakY
threatChecks.notes: A-8 / ADR-8 / R-7. Cards print Math.round(peak_y). Copy does not say verified/certified. Missing re-sim is pre-existing and out of scope — not a new critical.

threatChecks.threat: getOrCreate on public GET must not exist
threatChecks.notes: getShareableClimbRun is parse + findUnique. getOrCreateActiveSeason remains checkout/webhook only. Record page still uses getActiveSeason (read).

threatChecks.threat: Open redirects on tweet intent / compose URLs
threatChecks.notes: TWEET_INTENT_PREFIX is https://twitter.com/intent/tweet? + encodeURIComponent(caption). TikTok/YouTube compose have no url. ShareControls uses rel=noopener noreferrer and does not render <a href=''>.

threatChecks.threat: JSON-LD script injection via handle/peak on recording page
threatChecks.notes: Recording JSON-LD name/description interpolate peakMetres (number) only — handle is not in the script. Sink is jsonLdScriptHtml: JSON.stringify + replace < with \u003c. Record pages put display_name through the same escaper.
git diff origin/development...HEAD -- app/package.json is empty. Zero new packages. Did not re-audit the pre-existing tree (not introduced by this PR).

threatChecks.threat: Middleware is presence-only; recording pages must not treat it as ACL
threatChecks.notes: r/[id]/page.tsx has no requireAuth. generateMetadata is unauthenticated (404 via notFound, not 401). Matcher exclusion is document access, not an ACL pretending to authorize.

findings.issue: GET /r/{cuid} is capability-by-id: a valid id returns HTML that includes the replay token (ClimbPlayClient replayToken={token}). Old /play?r= token URLs were unguessable; short ids are enumerable. Share JSON and OG alt still omit the token/seed. Accepted by A-7 / R-1 / architecture §9 (playback token may appear in RSC, not in share JSON).
findings.reproduction: GET /r/{existing-cuid} as an unauthenticated client. The RSC payload contains the stored replay_token. GET /api/share/recording/{id} JSON.stringify(data) does not contain replay_token or seed.
findings.fix: No change required to ship unique OG. Do not sitemap /r/ (already true). Optional: keep token out of the initial HTML by loading playback only after a same-origin POST, if product later tightens R-1.

findings.issue: Share cards display client-reported persisted peak_y (monotonic Math.max on write). This PR does not add server re-sim. Per A-8 / ADR-8 / product-spec ping, that is untrusted display text, not a new critical introduced here. F-1 stays open.
findings.reproduction: Authenticated POST /api/climb/result with a self-reported peakY that passes scoreBounds still persists that peak. GET /r/{id} title/OG/share JSON show Math.round(peak_y) and 'Watch the replay' — they never say verified/certified.
findings.fix: Do not attach server-derived peak requirements to this change. Close F-1 in a separate ranked-re-sim story.

findings.issue: Middleware still forwards INTERNAL_TOKEN to request.nextUrl.origin for /stack and /b view credit (trust.md #4 / R-5). This PR did not copy that pattern onto OG/canonical/share URLs and did not add /r/ to the matcher. Fixing middleware Host-derived fetch is out of scope (R-5).
findings.reproduction: Unrelated to /r/: a GET /b/{slug} with a spoofable origin (only if experimental.trustHostHeader is enabled) would still send X-Internal-Token to that origin. GET /r/{id} never enters this branch.
findings.fix: Out of scope. Future hardening: pin credit-view fetch to resolveBaseUrl(), not request.nextUrl.origin.

findings.issue: sanitizeOgText(block.display_name, 80) || block.display_name falls back to the unsanitized string when the sanitizer returns empty (name that is only tags/controls). Listing OG uses a static default instead. ImageResponse treats children as text and Next metadata escapes HTML, so this is not XSS today; it undoes R-11 markup stripping for that edge case. Recording OG handle is React text and is not passed through sanitizeOgText (profile write already sanitizeDisplayName + length cap).
findings.reproduction: A listing whose display_name is only markup (e.g. '<script></script>') stores a non-empty name (checkout sanitizer does not strip tags). Record OG then uses the raw string because sanitizeOgText returns ''. PNG still renders it as glyphs; JSON-LD on /b/[slug] still runs through jsonLdScriptHtml.
findings.fix: If sanitized is empty, use a static fallback ('Stack'), never the raw value — same pattern as LISTING_OG_DEFAULTS. Optionally sanitizeOgText(handle) before RecordingOgCard.

feedback.message: jsonLd.test.ts invokes buildWebPageJsonLd but not jsonLdScriptHtml. Production pages use jsonLdScriptHtml (JSON.stringify + < escape) which is the XSS control. Recording JSON-LD does not interpolate handle. A </script> fixture against jsonLdScriptHtml would lock the sink; absence of that test is not a production hole.
feedback.action: Verifier/implementer: add a unit that calls jsonLdScriptHtml with name/description containing '' and asserts the output has no raw '<' and is not executable as a script breakout.

secretScan.notes: No new API keys, tokens, or private keys in origin/development...HEAD. Firebase web apiKey in public.ts is pre-existing and documented as public. INTERNAL_TOKEN is not referenced by new GET routes.

pnpmAudit: skipped — zero new packages in app/package.json vs origin/development

learnings.insight: JSON-LD XSS is at the script-tag sink (dangerouslySetInnerHTML), not at the object builder. jsonLdScriptHtml (JSON.stringify + replace < with \u003c) is the control; tests that only assert buildWebPageJsonLd shape do not prove the escape. Recording /r/{id} JSON-LD interpolates rounded peak metres only — handle is not in that script.
learnings.action: Invoke jsonLdScriptHtml with a '</script>' / '<img' fixture and assert the HTML payload has no raw '<'. Keep handle out of recording JSON-LD or run it through the same escaper.

learnings.insight: A PR that displays persisted peak_y as card text does not close F-1 and must not be failed for missing ranked re-sim. Spec A-8 / ADR-8: untrusted display. Cite those if a finding claims /r/{id} authenticates scores.
learnings.action: Security-reviewer and reviewer: do not mark missing server-derived peak as a new critical on share-SEO. Leave F-1 open for a dedicated re-sim change.

learnings.insight: Share-SEO diff vs origin/development: 0 critical, 0 high, 4 info (enumeration A-7, F-1 A-8, pre-existing middleware Host+INTERNAL_TOKEN R-5, sanitizer empty-fallback). Zero new npm packages. 12/12 required threats covered. Share JSON allow-list DTO + parseRecordingId reject-never-default + origin-only URL builders + matcher excluding /r/ are the load-bearing controls.
learnings.action: QA: treat AC-40 live Twitterbot GET as optional e2e; unit coverage is matcher + unauthenticated generateMetadata. Do not add /r/ to the view-credit matcher.
